summary.text: Wes Holden is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 17, challenging incumbent Tom Takubo (R) in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran who worked for Senator Jay Rockefeller for 30 years, he has run for office before.

paragraphs.text: Wes Holden was born in West Virginia and lives in Sissonville.
He served in the U.S. Army during the Vietnam War and attended West Virginia State University and the West Virginia College of Graduate Studies.
His career experience includes working for Senator Jay Rockefeller for 30 years and for eight years while Rockefeller was governor.
Holden ran for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 39, in 2016, when incumbent Ronald Walters (R) defeated him and Chris Reed in the general election.
In 2024 he ran as an Independent in the general election for West Virginia's 1st Congressional District and received 7.4 percent of the vote.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 17 on May 12, 2026.
